reading: This is a hero section for a summer apparel page: two stacked giant hollow-outlined 'SUMMER' headlines bleeding off the page edges, two overlapping tilted color-gradient blocks in front of them, three tilted pill badges ('New season', 'Linen only', 'Ships in 24h'), a small 'ORRA' wordmark, a two-line body paragraph, and a 'Shop summer →' link, all set against an off-white, grain-textured, Helvetica/dark-brown page style.
